name: zjournal
description: zJournal - A React TS based journal editor application (monorepo root)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix patrikaz && npm install --prefix analytics && npm run server:java:build
scripts.server:java:prod: npm run server:java:build && cd server/java && java -jar target/zjournal-server-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run start" "npm run server:dev" "npm run analytics:dev"
scripts.dev:host: concurrently "npm run start:host" "npm run server:dev" "npm run analytics:dev:host"
scripts.dev:php: concurrently "npm run start" "npm run server:php:dev" "npm run analytics:dev"
scripts.dev:php:host: concurrently "npm run start:host" "npm run server:php:dev:host" "npm run analytics:dev:host"
scripts.dev:java: concurrently "npm run start" "npm run server:java:dev" "npm run analytics:dev"
scripts.dev:java:host: concurrently "npm run start:host" "npm run server:java:dev:host" "npm run analytics:dev:host"
scripts.dev:python: concurrently "npm run start" "npm run server:python:dev" "npm run analytics:dev"
scripts.dev:python:host: concurrently "npm run start:host" "npm run server:python:dev:host" "npm run analytics:dev:host"
